## OUR STORY

India Internet Fund (IIF) was founded in 2011 as one of the first few venture capital funds focused on early stage technology investments. Founded by two entrepeneurs-turned-investors, Anirudh Suri and Nihal Mehta, IIF has invested in over 15 companies across a wide range of sectors, including media, entertainment, fin-tech, data analytics, AI, machine-learning, and logistics.

Our mission is to identify the best entrepreneurs that are building innovative internet and mobile technology-driven startups out of India targeting the Indian and the global markets. By leveraging our strong presence in the U.S. and India, we hope to help these startups evolve rapidly and in the process, promote greater cross-pollination between the startup ecosystems in India and the U.S.

Our goal is to help entrepreneurs turn their own ideas and visions into successful companies with fundraising and networking guidance. We are constantly looking for ambitious and visionary entrepreneurs with the drive and flexibility to take their company to the next level. For details about our investment process as well as our level of involvement, get in touch with us.
